sql: SELECT strategy, status, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT market_ticker) AS mkts, count(DISTINCT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) AS series, round(coalesce(sum(pnl),0)::numeric,2) AS pnl, round(avg(100-assumed_price)::numeric,2) AS avg_entry_c, min(created_at) AS first, max(created_at) AS last FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Rmmsell1','Rmmsell2') GROUP BY strategy, status ORDER BY strategy, status
